verdict.rationale: Databricks documents Unity Catalog governance that enforces access control on data/AI assets and lets agents get 'governed access' to third-party tools via Unity Catalog functions and MCP services (docs-19, 38, 70, 71, 43), implying a permissions model that could scope agent access. However, there is no explicit documentation of an API/credential-issuance mechanism (e.g., scoped service-principal tokens or OAuth scopes specifically for agents) described as 'least-privilege API credentials for an agent.' Missing for 10: explicit credential/token issuance workflow scoped to an agent identity, documentation of OAuth/service-principal scoping granularity, and any hands-on or independent confirmation that credentials can be narrowly scoped per-agent.
